urls.rationale: Chapter 13A - Lobbying Disclosure: the current lobbying-disclosure regime (65 Pa.C.S. Ch. 13A, sections 13A01-13A11), covering registration, expenditure/activity reporting, and gift disclosure.

notes: Chapter 13 (Lobby Regulation and Disclosure) is explicitly marked 'Deleted by amendment' in the 2015 vintage and is therefore not part of the live statute body. Chapter 11 (Ethics Standards and Financial Disclosure) is the general public-officer ethics regime and is not lobbying-coupled (consistent with PA 2010 exclusion).
